nodes.title: inPowered AI and Kantar Partner Exclusively  to Bring Brand Lift Optimization to Programmatic Advertising via Index Marketplaces

acf.title: inPowered AI and Kantar Partner Exclusively to Bring Brand Lift Optimization to Programmatic Advertising via Index Marketplaces
acf.summary: Moving programmatic beyond proxy metrics by connecting brand lift measurement directly to impression-level optimization.
acf.text_1:
inPowered AI, the leading sell-side AI decisioning company, today announced an exclusive partnership with Kantar, the world’s leading AI-native marketing data and analytics business, to enable true brand lift optimization in programmatic advertising through AI PMPs (Private Marketplace deals) running via Index Marketplaces.

For the first time, advertisers can move beyond optimizing toward proxy metrics like viewability or CTR. Through this partnership, inPowered AI and Kantar make it possible to train and activate custom AI algorithms for each brand using that brand’s own Kantar-measured brand lift data through their LIFT solution – enabling campaigns to optimize toward real outcomes such as awareness, favorability, and purchase intent.

Using Kantar’s trusted brand lift insights as training data, inPowered AI’s proprietary Sell-Side Decisioning models are deployed directly within Index Exchange’s containerized infrastructure. These models learn which environments, audiences, and moments most strongly correlate with positive brand lift results, and then make impression-level decisions in real time to maximize brand impact.
acf.text_2:
Each participating brand will have a dedicated AI model trained on its proprietary Kantar brand lift study data, ensuring that the optimization logic reflects the brand’s unique creative, audience, and contextual performance drivers. These brand-specific AI PMPs dynamically curate in real-time impressions most likely to increase brand lift, rather than relying on indirect proxies.

“A common challenge we solve for our clients is how to supercharge new customer growth, with brand building playing a critical role,” said Ben Kahan, Head of Programmatic, North America, Brainlabs. “At Brainlabs, we apply a test-and-learn approach to understand which objectives and creatives truly drive brand building. Being able to directly optimize media toward Kantar-measured brand lift – awareness, favorability, and consideration – is a step forward in how we deliver outcomes for our clients. We’re thrilled to be a launch partner for this solution and excited to help lead the shift away from proxy-based optimization toward truly outcome-driven media buying.”

“This partnership allows us to take Kantar’s LIFT measurement beyond reporting and into real-time optimization,” said Gregory Friend, SVP, Head of Media Product, Kantar North America, Kantar. “By pairing our outcome data with inPowered AI’s decisioning models, advertisers can now leverage custom algorithms powered by their own Kantar LIFT results – creating a true closed loop between measurement and activation.”

The partnership is now live via Index Marketplaces. AI PMPs trained on Kantar LIFT data are available for activation by agencies and brands through their existing buying platforms.
acf.quote: “Advertisers have always measured brand lift, but they’ve never been able to optimize to it - until now,” said Pirouz Nilforoush, Co-Founder and President of inPowered AI. “By combining Kantar’s LIFT gold-standard outcome data with our on-exchange AI platform on Index Exchange, we can build custom algorithms for each brand trained on its own Kantar brand lift data - finally bringing true brand lift optimization to programmatic.”

nodes.title: inPowered AI Becomes the Fastest-Growing Containerized Solution on Index Marketplaces Since Its Launch

acf.title: inPowered AI Becomes the Fastest-Growing Containerized Solution on Index Marketplaces Since Its Launch
acf.summary: Breakout Growth Driven by Buyer Demand for On-Exchange AI, Cementing inPowered AI’s Leadership in Sell-Side Decisioning
acf.text_1:
Backed by Leaders from The Trade Desk, Mediaocean, MoPub, and Beeswax, inPowered AI Expands Its On-Exchange AI Platform

inPowered AI, the leading sell-side AI decisioning company, announced today that it has become the fastest-growing containerized solution on Index Marketplaces since its launch. This rapid growth reflects surging buyer demand for on-exchange AI that delivers measurable outcomes and greater transparency for advertisers, agencies, and publishers.

As one of the first companies integrated into Index Exchange’s containerized infrastructure, inPowered AI enables real-time, model-driven decisioning directly within the exchange. This architecture allows agencies and brands to optimize private marketplace (PMP) deals using granular, high-signal variables such as contextual data, impression history, and publisher metadata – driving stronger performance at the speed of the auction.
acf.text_2:
Paul Zovighian, VP of Marketplaces at Index Exchange, added: “The rapid adoption of inPowered AI within Index Marketplaces speaks volumes. It reflects real demand for sell-side decisioning that’s measurable, efficient, and native to the supply path. Media buyers are looking for innovation that delivers performance without adding friction, and that’s exactly what inPowered AI delivers.”

The company’s breakout trajectory underscores a broader industry shift toward enabling intelligence closer to the auction, where the fastest and most valuable signals live. inPowered AI’s on-exchange models are already powering performance-driven campaigns across major brand and agency partners, establishing it as the leader in sell-side AI decisioning.
acf.quote: The pace of adoption we've seen from media buyers has been extraordinary, said Peyman Nilforoush, Co-Founder and CEO of inPowered AI. The results prove what we've believed all along: the next frontier of programmatic intelligence lives on the sell-side. By operating directly within the exchange, we're able to make smarter, faster decisions that drive measurable results for our clients.

nodes.title: inPowered AI Raises $5M from AdTech Veterans to Accelerate Sell-Side AI Decisioning

acf.title: inPowered AI Raises $5M from AdTech Veterans to Accelerate Sell-Side AI Decisioning
acf.summary: Architects of Programmatic from Google, Mediaocean, MoPub, and Beeswax Unite Behind inPowered AI, Betting on the Next Evolution - On-Exchange Intelligence
acf.text_1:
Architects of Programmatic from Google, Mediaocean, MoPub, and Beeswax Unite Behind inPowered AI, Betting on the Next Evolution – On-Exchange Intelligence

As AI reshapes the future of digital advertising, inPowered AI, the leading sell-side AI decisioning company, announced it has raised $5 million in strategic funding to bring real-time, outcome-based intelligence directly to where digital auctions happen – the sell side.

The round is backed by adtech pioneers Gokul Rajaram (Investor & Product Leader, ex-Facebook Ads & Google), Bill Wise (Co-Founder & CEO, Mediaocean), Jim Payne (Co-Founder, MoPub), and Ari Paparo (Co-Founder, Beeswax) – the very leaders who helped build the foundations of modern programmatic advertising. Their collective investment marks a powerful signal that the next era of adtech innovation will be driven by AI decisioning on the exchange itself.
acf.text_2:
“For too long, advertisers have been forced to optimize toward proxy metrics like viewability or CTR instead of real business outcomes,” said Peyman Nilforoush, Co-Founder and CEO of inPowered AI. “By moving decisioning intelligence directly onto the exchange, we’re closing that gap – enabling brands to optimize for what truly matters.”

“When you see the kind of performance inPowered AI delivers, it’s clear why this is resonating within the marketplace,” added Bill Wise, Co-Founder & CEO of Mediaocean. “They’re proving that when AI operates at the source of the auction, it can drive outcomes that simply weren’t possible before.”

inPowered AI’s platform enables agencies, brands, and media companies to deliver stronger results through Private Marketplace (PMP) deals powered by real-time AI decisioning. By operating directly within the exchange, its models analyze contextual relevance, impression history, bid dynamics, and publisher metadata – driving measurable outcomes at the speed of the auction.

The funding builds on growing market adoption of on-exchange AI, positioning inPowered AI to redefine how value is created across the open web – aligning publisher yield and advertiser outcomes through a single, intelligent system.
acf.quote: “AI is Transforming the entire digital advertising ecosystem,” said Gokul Rajaram, Investor & Product Leader (ex-Facebook Ads & Google). “It’s unlocking new levels of intelligence, speed, and creativity in how we drive outcomes. inPowered AI embodies the kind of breakthrough innovation that’s redefining what’s possible.”
